name: Quest format fixture facts
notes: Facts the fixture quests (mw-e23.1) read and write. Never shipped; the real quest facts are written under E39.

facts.description: Juniper has told the player the Captain's boots are dusty every morning. Starts The Captain's Boots (format fixture).
The player followed the Captain at night as far as the Bell Line stones.
The player learned the sleepwalkers' route to the Briarwood shortcut.
The Captain drank Juniper's wakeful tea.
The Captain drank the sleep draught by mistake and walked all the way in.
The Captain agreed to be tied to his bed at night.
A bell hangs on the Captain's door.
The Briarwood shortcut to the priory is known.
The Captain is home from the mine, safe.
The Watch has been sent into the mine after the Captain.
Clatter's psalter has been found among the Forgotten.
The dead pear tree in the priory garden has bloomed once.
The Pell family letter from Clatter's sister is in the player's hands.
The letter was taken without Hollis knowing.
